register.title: Mishapolk's square-packing-records at 46f638c, issue593
register.headline: Mishapolk's certificate for 237 squares, the smallest known side there; the other 72 restate or trail earlier certificates
register.source_checks: The author reports that Evan Daniel's verify_cert.py and verify_cert2.py and this repository's sqpack/verify.py, run from copies outside the pinned tree, accept all 73 certificates with zero tolerance in 219 runs taking 43.9 seconds. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Mishapolk (the issue gives Mykhailo Polkovskyi and Mikhail Polk) with the certificate at 237, which the issue's lineage column assigns to a refinement of Francisco Couzo's packing (#561, itself a continuation of Nate Chaoweeraprasit's SQUISH packing). The issue claims all 73 as beating or tying every standing and pending record; measured here, 13 of the files are byte for byte certificates by Evan Daniel (70, 102, 123, 269, 292, 295) and Francisco Couzo (105, 108, 127, 209, 267, 305, 306), 40 have the case's exact side, and at 129, 176, 204, 303 and 304 the side is within 1e-30 of Daniil Ostashev's earlier issues 562 and 575, at 211 and 241 it equals Couzo's b85dee2 certificates exactly, and at 156 and 271 it matches Couzo's issue 561 at 12 places. No pose comparison has been made, so no finding of copying or of independent rediscovery is made either. The source discloses Gemini 3.8 assistance with solver scripting, precision checks and formatting.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay at 211, 237 and 241, and weigh adoption at 237 only, where the side is below the case ceiling (T-140) by 2.45e-04 and below Couzo's issue 561 and PR 574 by 2.43e-04. At 211 and 241 the side equals Couzo's b85dee2 certificate; decide priority and credit with Ostashev's issue 575 before any entry. Settle the credit name. Replay the other 69 certificates (priced at about 4 hours of one-worker wall for certify and replay) only if a count is registered. Final exact-head CI remains required.

bibliography.note: Seventy-three complete exact certificates at 46f638ce0537beeb1bad24242c6a3d357eecd9ee in Evan Daniel's format, issue 593, each admitted at the exact side_fraction of the release's census. Thirteen are byte for byte other authors' certificates already retained here and 40 state the case's exact side; the smallest known side only at 237.
